statement: Let Q be a collection of distinct unit lattice cubes in a ball of radius S ≥ 1. Suppose their counting function in every ball of radius r ≥ 1 is at most Γrn, and their number in any ball of radius √ S is at most λ0. Then for every ε > 0, X q∈Q sup q |Eg|2 ≤ CεSε Γ4/((n+1)(n+2)) λγn 0 Sγn ∥g∥2 2. (4.7) All fixed enlargements and translations of the cube lattice are allowed, with fixed changes of the constant.
